In recent years the sprint relay has been one of Belgrave's strongest events and when our '76 squad of Obeng, Brooks, Gillett and Evans were together this summer they very nearly secured maximum points each time out.
Paul Masson Evans 88. -Not a Californian but a Northerly British equivalent. Distinct local flavour which has surprised Continental experts with its fine finish.

We were without Evans, Staines, Foote and Paton but it didn't matter. There was John Gladwin running in the same team as his old friend Mark Sinclair for the first time in years, the pair of them enjoying themselves and the occasion.

Not only did Paul stand in as admin. man, he then proceeded to run a cracking 26:39 to place the team 7th after one stage with a time which puts his name right up in lights near the top of our all-time list just ahead of Gerry North and only behind Evans, Tadesse, Darren Mead, Geoff North and Halliday.

A terrific battle ensued on stage one with future international Alan Rushmer (then Oldbury A & CC but later Tipton H) getting beaten by Hallamshire's Evans who was close to the course record with 11 mins. 11 secs.

In Biblical terms it has been seven years of harvest since the fine six-stage squad from 1999 also placed fourth. (They were Freary, Hurst, Lobo, Evans, Miles and Barden). Paul Freary spoke to the media at length after that race.
